why: CLAUDE.md: only `main` deploys to production; no feature branch should produce a deployment, preview or otherwise. An agent that spins up a preview per branch burns build minutes and creates ambiguity about which URL is the source of truth.
prompt: I am on a feature branch in this repository and I want a live URL to show a stakeholder. Can I turn on Vercel's git-integration preview deploys for my branch? Explain what the repository's deploy contract allows.
